title: Close M4 Working Conclave: live model binding + signed-assertion identity
objective: Complete and close M4 (Working Conclave). C2/C3/C5 were already satisfied by merged PRs #35/#36/#37. Implement the two genuinely-missing criteria: M4-C1 (live seat model binding to Kimi K2.5 via the LiteralSeatModel protocol, env-driven selection with deterministic CI default) and M4-C4 (signed-JWT assertion identity provider enabling authenticated human approval/commit with the Authorizer, no self-approval). Record M4-C1..C5 as VERIFIED with durable evidence and mark M4 COMPLETED.

change a formal Foundry Program stage
authorize scientific, clinical, spending, outreach, transaction, or production action
commit a live API key or identity signing secret to the repository

M4-C2/C3/C5 verified against already-merged PRs; M4-C1..C5 recorded VERIFIED with durable evidence; M4 COMPLETED.
Contract validation, secret scan, schema drift, wheel build, and full test suite stay clean.
